purpose: Explicit additive bindings for repository-native tooling and closeout behavior implemented or owned outside the original runtime-oriented task reference arrays.

bindings.rationale: The deterministic Spec-local work-packet generator binds task, wave, scope, source revision, tests, gates, evidence, resume key, work-packet ID, and plan hash without granting mutation authority.
The closeout task owns separate reporting of implemented, verified, blocked, deferred, cancelled, and unowned work, and must fail when authoritative evidence is incomplete.
